name: Krimm
source:
Human barbarian.

From the Age of Fallen Kingdoms, a few barbarian tribes still wander the world, and Krimm is a member of one of the proudest, the Clan of the Stalking Sabertooth.

She is a fierce and strong woman, in combat a challenge for even the greatest warriors -- but at the moment, she is nothing but a lone wolf, having lost her honor and thus fallen from grace with her clan. She would give anything were she able to redeem herself, though she knows that this may well be impossible, and that thought makes her heart heavy and her mood glum.

Maybe she can find solace in rage, for it is rage that powers her prowess in battle -- and there may be much to be angry about in her future...

[From [url=http://www.winterwolves.net/viewtopic.php?f=40&t=3053]Winter Wolves[/url]]
